create.title: Create
create.postSub: write it up — embed YouTube / TikTok
create.debateSub: pick a fight, let the votes decide

lowDetail.footerTitle: Turn off the animated backgrounds and glass effects for slower devices
lowDetail.label: Low detail mode
lowDetail.description: Holds the liquid light still, turns off the film grain and glass blur, and stops the decorative animations — the same diet the phone app runs. Everything else works exactly the same. On by default; turn it off for the full animated look if your machine can take it. Remembered on this device only.

language.label: Language
language.description: Menus, buttons and labels in your language. Reviews, lists and posts always stay the way their authors wrote them. Remembered on this device.

settings.performanceHint: Low detail mode — on by default, switch it off for the full effects.
settings.languageHint: English, Español, Français, Português, Nederlands, Deutsch.

plug.title: For a better experience, check out our website
plug.body: on a computer — the big-screen home for proper sit-down reviews.

hero.tagline: every album. every leak. every argument.
hero.copy: Rate albums and leaks 0–10, build lists, follow people, and be in the live room when an album drops at midnight. Free, on web and iOS.

dashboard.title: HOME
dashboard.tasteTitle: Want a channel tuned to just you?
dashboard.tasteBody: Your Taste builds a feed from who you follow and what you rate.

closing.title: Start the log you'll actually keep.
closing.body: Free. Your first rating takes two taps. Web and iOS.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. Then it's your channel.
howItWorks.sub: Find it, rate it, say it out loud.
howItWorks.step1Body: Every album and single on Spotify, plus Genius for leaks and unreleased. Not out yet? Paste the Spotify link and it gets a countdown.
howItWorks.step1Prop: search any album, song, or artist…
howItWorks.step2Body: Zero to ten, one decimal. Your number shows on every card you post, colored by the score.
howItWorks.step3Body: Every release has a live room, open before the album drops at midnight. Want a fight? Start a two-sided debate.
howItWorks.step3Prop: “track 4 is the one, argue with a wall”
howItWorks.stepFour: step four is optional and it's <link>lists</link>. everyone ends up making lists.

liveRooms.title: Every release has a room. Midnight is when it fills up.
liveRooms.sub: The album drops, the room is already open, and the whole platform is in there track by track.
liveRooms.point1B: Reactions land as the tracklist plays. You can tell which song the room is on.
liveRooms.point2B: Countdown albums get a room before release. The chat is live at 11:59.
liveRooms.point3B: Rooms are public. Sign up to talk and rate.
liveRooms.point4B: Two sides, one record each, the room votes.
liveRooms.chat1: track 4 just started. it's the one.
liveRooms.chat2: the sample flip on the outro 😭
liveRooms.chat3: nah track 2 clears. argue with me
liveRooms.chat4: 7.8 from me, could go up on a relisten

makeItYours.title: A profile that's a channel, not a form.
makeItYours.sub: Ten themes, showcases you arrange, your own preview player, a song and a playlist on your profile.
makeItYours.themesBody: Ten looks from console eras and internet history. Each one recolors the whole page.
makeItYours.showcasesBody: Put the blocks in the order you want: histogram, pinned review, what's on rotation.
makeItYours.playerBody: Spotify or Apple Music on every release page. Signed in, previews become full tracks.
makeItYours.badgesBody: Verified reviewers, early testers, staff, each with its own glow. Regular members don't wear one.
makeItYours.songLabel: A song and a playlist on the door
makeItYours.songBody: A profile song that plays when someone lands on you, plus a featured Spotify playlist with its own player.
makeItYours.playlist: Featured playlist · 100 tracks · save it as a list
makeItYours.tasteBody: A fullscreen feed tuned to who you follow and what you rate, one take at a time, music playing under it.
makeItYours.nextUp: next up: a 9.2 from someone you follow

community.title: What the community rated
community.sub: One tile per record, rated by a member. Tap a cover to read the review.

unreleased.title: If it exists, you can rate it.
unreleased.sub: Spotify is the floor. Genius brings the leaks and loosies, and a pasted Spotify link puts an announced album here before it's out, countdown included.
unreleased.b1: Songs that never got a release get a page, a rating, and a room like anything else.
unreleased.b2: Paste an announced album's Spotify link. It gets a countdown to midnight Eastern and a room.
unreleased.b3: Bandcamp-only, private press, regional. Email us the link and it's added by hand.

dropBox.albumLinksOnly: Spotify ALBUM links only — open the upcoming album on Spotify, hit share, and paste the link here.
dropBox.cantRead: Couldn't read that link — double-check it and try again.

dropBox.hiccup: Something hiccuped — try again in a moment.
dropBox.placeholder: Paste an upcoming album's Spotify link…
dropBox.ariaLabel: Spotify link to an upcoming album

dropping.title: Dropping Soon
dropping.addBody: Know an album that's coming? Paste its Spotify link and the countdown page + live room open before the album does.

forgot.emailHint: Your email, not your username — reset links only travel by mail.

welcome.freeNote: This one's free — after it, usernames change once every 2 weeks.
